label: Community — creators, streamers, a game in the making
summary: Announcements only moderators post in, feedback and bug reports, a stage for events, playtests, and a locked 18+ area.
notes: A big community needs room: raise max_users in server.toml (64 by default).
Posting in an announcement channel takes an admin (the admin token) or, on a server with accounts, a moderator.
The 18+ channels ask every member to confirm their age before opening them, but a click proves nothing: their password, handed out by moderators after an age check, is the real gate.
max_channels is 10 here, so rooms members open with + cannot flood the list.
